meanings.explanation: If something [is likely to happen], it has a good chance of happening. You use this phrase to say that something will probably happen in the future.

examples.english: It [is likely to rain] this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.chinese: 今天下午很[可能下雨]，所以带把伞吧。

examples.english: She [is likely to win] the singing competition because she practices every day.
examples.chinese: 她每天练习，所以很[可能赢得]歌唱比赛。

examples.english: We [are likely to be late] if we don't leave now.
examples.chinese: 如果我们现在不走，就[很可能会]迟到。

meanings.explanation: An [adult] is a person who has grown up and is no longer a child.

examples.english: My dad is an [adult], so he goes to work every day.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸是[大人]，所以他每天去上班。

examples.english: When I grow up, I will become an [adult].
examples.chinese: 我长大以后就会变成[大人]了。

examples.english: In the game, you can play as a kid or an [adult].
examples.chinese: 在游戏里，你可以扮演小孩或者[大人]。

common_collocations: as a result of the rain

meanings.explanation: You use [as a result] to say that something happens because of something else.

examples.english: It rained all night. [As a result], the soccer game was canceled.
examples.chinese: 下了一整夜的雨，[因此]足球比赛取消了。

examples.english: Lily forgot her lunch. [As a result], she felt hungry at school.
examples.chinese: 莉莉忘了带午饭，[所以]她在学校觉得饿了。

examples.english: Ben practiced reading every day. [As a result], he read the story very well.
examples.chinese: 本每天练习阅读，[结果]故事读得很好。

It's your job to do sth..word: It's your job to do sth.
derived_forms: It's my job to do sth.
It's his job to do sth.
It's their job to do sth.
common_collocations: It's your job to do the dishes
It's your job to do the cleaning
It's your job to do the shopping

meanings.explanation: [It's your job to do sth.] is used to say that you are the person who is responsible for doing a particular thing.

examples.english: After dinner, [It's your job to do the dishes] at home.
examples.chinese: 在家里，晚饭后洗碗[是你的任务]。

examples.english: When we plan a party, [It's your job to do the invitation] for all our friends.
examples.chinese: 我们办派对时，给所有朋友发邀请[是你的事儿]。

examples.english: Every Saturday morning, [It's your job to do the cleaning] of your bedroom.
examples.chinese: 每个周六早上，打扫卧室[是你的活儿]。

synonyms: It's your responsibility to do sth.
It's up to you to do sth.
You're in charge of doing sth.

derived_forms: at the very end of (emphatic variant)
at the end of the day (idiomatic variant)
common_collocations: at the end of the street
at the end of the term
at the end of the book

meanings.explanation: [At the end of] something means it is at the furthest or final point of that thing, whether that thing is a place, a period of time, or a written work.

examples.english: My home is [at the end of] this street.
examples.chinese: 我家在这条街的[尽头]。

examples.english: We get two weeks off [at the end of] every school term.
examples.chinese: 每个学期[结束时]我们会放两周假。

examples.english: You can find the answers [at the end of] your math workbook.
examples.chinese: 你可以在数学练习册的[末尾]找到答案。

meanings.explanation: A [choir] is a group of people who sing together, like a team of singers.

examples.english: My sister sings in the school [choir] every Friday.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐每周五都在学校[合唱团]唱歌。

examples.english: The [choir] sang a beautiful song at the Christmas show.
examples.chinese: [合唱团]在圣诞汇演上唱了一首动听的歌。

examples.english: I want to join the [choir] because I love singing with my friends.
examples.chinese: 我想加入[合唱团]，因为我喜欢和朋友们一起唱歌。

meanings.explanation: If you [break into] something such as a run, laughter, or song, you suddenly start doing it.

examples.english: My little sister [broke into] song while walking to school.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹走路上学时，突然[唱起了歌]。

examples.english: When Dad told a funny joke, everyone [broke into] laughter.
examples.chinese: 爸爸讲了个好笑的笑话，大家都[哈哈大笑]起来。

examples.english: The children [broke into] a run when they saw the ice cream truck.
examples.chinese: 孩子们看到冰淇淋车时，都[跑了起来]。

meanings.explanation: When you [apologize], you tell someone you are sorry for doing something wrong or hurting their feelings.

examples.english: I want to [apologize] for breaking your toy car.
examples.chinese: 我想为弄坏你的玩具车[道歉]。

examples.english: She [apologized] to her friend for being late.
examples.chinese: 她因为迟到向朋友[道了歉]。

examples.english: You should [apologize] when you accidentally bump into someone.
examples.chinese: 不小心撞到别人时，你应该[道歉]。

meanings.explanation: [Climate change] is when the weather on Earth becomes very different from what it used to be, like getting much hotter or having more storms, because of things people do.

examples.english: Many animals are losing their homes because of [climate change].
examples.chinese: 许多动物因为[气候变化]而失去了家园。

examples.english: We can help slow down [climate change] by planting trees and saving energy.
examples.chinese: 我们可以通过种树和节约能源来帮助减缓[气候变化]。

examples.english: My teacher says [climate change] is making the weather hotter in many places.
examples.chinese: 我的老师说[气候变化]正在让许多地方变得更热。

meanings.explanation: A [challenging] task, activity, or problem is difficult and tests your ability and effort to complete it.

examples.english: This 100-piece jigsaw puzzle is really [challenging] for me.
examples.chinese: 这套100片的拼图对我来说真的很[有挑战性]。

examples.english: Climbing to the top of the playground rope ladder is [challenging] but exciting.
examples.chinese: 爬到操场绳梯的顶端既[有挑战性]又刺激。

examples.english: My dad gives me a [challenging] problem to solve every weekend.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸每个周末都会给我出一道[有挑战性]的题目来做。

meanings.explanation: A [billion] is the number 1,000,000,000, or one thousand million.

examples.english: There are more than a [billion] stars in our galaxy.
examples.chinese: 我们的银河系里有超过[十亿]颗恒星。

examples.english: The video got a [billion] views.
examples.chinese: 这个视频的观看次数达到了[十亿]。

examples.english: A [billion] is much bigger than a million.
examples.chinese: [十亿]比一百万大得多。

meanings.explanation: If something is [around] a place, it is near that place or on every side of it.

examples.english: The cat ran [around] the tree.
examples.chinese: 猫[绕着]树跑了一圈。

examples.english: We sat [around] the campfire and sang songs.
examples.chinese: 我们[围着]篝火坐下来唱歌。

examples.english: There are beautiful flowers all [around] the house.
examples.chinese: 房子[四周]开满了漂亮的花。

common_collocations: compare your answers with your partner's
compare this picture with that picture
compare the prices with other stores

meanings.explanation: If you [compare A with B], you look at A and B to see how they are alike or how they are different.

examples.english: Let's [compare my drawing with your drawing] and see which one we like better.
examples.chinese: 我们来[比较]一下我的画和你的画，看看更喜欢哪一幅。

examples.english: Mom asked me to [compare the red apple with the green apple] to find the sweeter one.
examples.chinese: 妈妈让我[比较]一下红苹果和绿苹果，找出哪个更甜。

examples.english: In class, we [compared our answers with our partner's answers] to check for mistakes.
examples.chinese: 课堂上，我们[对照]了搭档的答案来检查有没有错误。

synonyms: look at A and B side by side
see how A and B are alike or different

meanings.explanation: A [container] is an object used for holding or carrying something.

examples.english: Please put your lunch in this [container].
examples.chinese: 请把午饭放进这个[盒子]里。

examples.english: The glass [container] holds water.
examples.chinese: 这个玻璃[容器]里装着水。

examples.english: We use a small [container] to carry crayons.
examples.chinese: 我们用一个小[盒子]装蜡笔。

meanings.explanation: A [crime] is something that people do that is against the law.

examples.english: Taking something that does not belong to you is a [crime].
examples.chinese: 拿走不属于你的东西是一种[犯罪]。

examples.english: The police work hard to stop [crime] in our city.
examples.chinese: 警察努力阻止我们城市的[犯罪]。

examples.english: It is a [crime] to hurt someone on purpose.
examples.chinese: 故意伤害别人是[犯罪]。

meanings.explanation: [Courage] is the quality that allows someone to face danger, fear, or difficulty without being afraid.

examples.english: It took [courage] for me to tell my mom I broke her favorite cup.
examples.chinese: 我告诉妈妈我打碎了她最爱的杯子，这需要[勇气]。

examples.english: The firefighter showed great [courage] when he saved the little boy from the burning house.
examples.chinese: 消防员从着火的房子里救出小男孩时展现了巨大的[勇气]。

examples.english: Do you have the [courage] to go into the dark room by yourself?
examples.chinese: 你有[勇气]一个人走进那间黑屋子吗？

meanings.explanation: If something is happening [currently], it is happening now, at this present time.

examples.english: I am [currently] reading a fun storybook before bed.
examples.chinese: 我[目前]正在睡前读一本有趣的故事书。

examples.english: My family is [currently] living in a small house near the park.
examples.chinese: 我家[现在]住在公园附近的一栋小房子里。

examples.english: The teacher is [currently] helping the students with their math homework.
examples.chinese: 老师[正在]辅导学生们做数学作业。

meanings.explanation: A [comparative] is the form of an adjective or adverb that we use when comparing two people or things. For example, 'bigger' is the comparative of 'big'.

examples.english: 'Bigger' is the [comparative] of 'big'.
examples.chinese: 'bigger'是'big'的[比较级]。

examples.english: Can you tell me the [comparative] of 'tall'?
examples.chinese: 你能告诉我'tall'的[比较级]是什么吗？

examples.english: We learned how to form [comparatives] in English class today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天在英语课上学习了如何构成[比较级]。

derived_forms: challenges sb. to do sth. (third-person singular)
challenged sb. to do sth. (past tense)
challenging sb. to do sth. (present participle)
common_collocations: challenge a friend to solve a puzzle
challenge the team to work together

meanings.explanation: If you [challenge someone to do something], you ask or dare them to try it, often as a game or test.

examples.english: My sister [challenged me to jump over the small puddle].
examples.chinese: 我姐姐[挑战我跳过那个小水坑]。

examples.english: The coach [challenged the children to run to the big tree].
examples.chinese: 教练[挑战孩子们跑到那棵大树那里]。

examples.english: Ben [challenged his friend to build the tallest block tower].
examples.chinese: 本[挑战朋友搭出最高的积木塔]。

meanings.explanation: To [deforest] an area means to cut down or remove all the trees from that place.

examples.english: People should not [deforest] the land because animals need trees to live.
examples.chinese: 人们不应该[砍伐]土地上的树木，因为动物需要树木才能生存。

examples.english: The company [deforested] a large area to build new houses.
examples.chinese: 这家公司[砍伐]了一大片区域的树木来盖新房子。

examples.english: If we [deforest] too many forests, the Earth will get warmer.
examples.chinese: 如果我们[砍伐]太多森林，地球会变得更热。

meanings.explanation: [Carbon] is a very common chemical element that is found in all living things and in materials such as coal, oil, and diamonds.

examples.english: All living things are made of [carbon].
examples.chinese: 所有生物都是由[碳]组成的。

examples.english: Diamonds are made of pure [carbon].
examples.chinese: 钻石是由纯净的[碳]构成的。

examples.english: Plants take in [carbon] dioxide from the air to grow.
examples.chinese: 植物从空气中吸收[碳]来生长。

derived_forms: compares A to B (third person singular)
common_collocations: compare the world to a stage

meanings.explanation: If you [compare one thing to another], you say that it is similar to it, usually to describe it more clearly or to praise it.

examples.english: People often [compare a brave person to a lion].
examples.chinese: 人们常[把勇敢的人比作狮子]。

examples.english: My teacher [compared my drawing to a famous painting].
examples.chinese: 老师[把我的画比作一幅名画]。

examples.english: Grandma [compared her life to a beautiful story].
examples.chinese: 奶奶[把她的生活比作一个美丽的故事]。

meanings.explanation: If something [comes of] an action or situation, it happens as a result of that action or situation.

examples.english: What good will [come of] staying up so late?
examples.chinese: 熬这么晚能[得出]什么好处呢？

examples.english: Nothing good [came of] breaking the neighbor's window.
examples.chinese: 打碎邻居窗户这件事没[落得]好结果。

examples.english: I wonder what [comes of] mixing red and blue paint.
examples.chinese: 我很好奇红色和蓝色颜料混合[会产生]什么颜色。

meanings.explanation: If something is [expensive], it costs a lot of money to buy.

examples.english: This toy is too [expensive] for me to buy with my pocket money.
examples.chinese: 这个玩具太[贵]了，我的零花钱不够买。

examples.english: Mom said the new bicycle was [expensive], so we saved up for it.
examples.chinese: 妈妈说新自行车很[贵]，所以我们攒钱买它。

examples.english: We did not eat at that restaurant because it is too [expensive].
examples.chinese: 我们没在那家餐厅吃饭，因为太[贵]了。

meanings.explanation: If you are [alone], you are by yourself, without any other people with you.

examples.english: I like to read [alone] in my room.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢[独自]在房间里看书。

examples.english: She was [alone] at home yesterday.
examples.chinese: 她昨天[一个人]在家。

examples.english: Don't leave the baby [alone].
examples.chinese: 不要把宝宝[单独]留下。

meanings.explanation: [Deforestation] is the cutting down or removal of large areas of forest.

examples.english: Large areas of forest are lost because of [deforestation].
examples.chinese: 大片森林因为[森林砍伐]而消失。

examples.english: Trees are cut down for farms, causing [deforestation].
examples.chinese: 为了建农场，人们砍掉了很多树，造成了[森林砍伐]。

examples.english: Planting trees can help slow [deforestation] and protect wild animals.
examples.chinese: 植树可以帮助减缓[森林砍伐]，保护野生动物。

meanings.explanation: [Encouragement] is kind words or actions that help someone feel brave and keep trying when something is hard.

examples.english: My dad gave me lots of [encouragement] when I learned to ride my bike.
examples.chinese: 我学骑自行车时，爸爸给了我很多[鼓励]。

examples.english: The teacher's [encouragement] made me want to try my best on the test.
examples.chinese: 老师的[鼓励]让我想尽最大努力考好这次试。

examples.english: A little [encouragement] from a friend can make a sad day better.
examples.chinese: 朋友的一点[鼓励]就能让难过的一天变好。

meanings.explanation: To [express] a feeling, idea, or opinion is to show or communicate it in words, actions, or pictures.

examples.english: I [expressed] my feelings by drawing a happy picture.
examples.chinese: 我用画一幅开心的画来[表达]自己的感受。

examples.english: Please [express] your ideas clearly.
examples.chinese: 请清楚地[表达]你的想法。

examples.english: Ben [expressed] his thanks with a big smile.
examples.chinese: 本用灿烂的笑容[表达]了谢意。

meanings.explanation: When you [face a challenge], you have to deal with a difficult problem or situation.

examples.english: When I climb a tall mountain, I [face a challenge] but I keep going.
examples.chinese: 当我爬高山时，我会[面临挑战]，但我会坚持下去。

examples.english: I [faced a challenge] when I learned how to swim last summer.
examples.chinese: 去年夏天我学游泳时，[面临了挑战]。

examples.english: Every student will [face a challenge] when they take a big test.
examples.chinese: 每个学生参加大型考试时都会[面临挑战]。

common_collocations: never give up on your friends

meanings.explanation: If you [give up on sb.], you stop trying to help them, stop believing they can succeed, or stop hoping they will change.

examples.english: My teacher never [gave up on me], even when I got bad grades.
examples.chinese: 就算我考了低分，我的老师也从来没有[放弃我]。

examples.english: Don't [give up on your friend] just because he made a mistake.
examples.chinese: 不要因为你的朋友犯了错就[放弃他]。

examples.english: Mom and Dad always believe in me, so they will never [give up on me].
examples.chinese: 爸爸妈妈总是相信我，所以他们永远不会[放弃我]。

meanings.explanation: A [glass] is a container made of hard, clear material that you use for drinking.

examples.english: I drink a [glass] of milk every morning.
examples.chinese: 我每天早上喝一[杯]牛奶。

examples.english: Could you please give me a clean [glass]?
examples.chinese: 请给我一个干净的[玻璃杯]好吗？

examples.english: Tom filled his [glass] with orange juice.
examples.chinese: 汤姆给自己的[杯子]倒满了橙汁。

derived_forms: has an effect on (third person singular)

meanings.explanation: To [have an effect on] someone or something means to change or influence them in some way.

examples.english: The rain [has an effect on] how fast the plants grow.
examples.chinese: 雨水对植物生长的速度有[影响]。

examples.english: Eating too much candy [has an effect on] your teeth.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖果对你的牙齿有[影响]。

examples.english: My teacher's kind words [had an effect on] me.
examples.chinese: 老师亲切的话语对我产生了[影响]。

meanings.explanation: When people or animals [fight], they use their bodies to try to hurt or stop each other, usually because they are angry or want something.

examples.english: The brave knight [fought] the dragon to save the princess.
examples.chinese: 勇敢的骑士为了救公主而[战斗]巨龙。

examples.english: My brother and I sometimes [fight] over toys, but we always make up later.
examples.chinese: 我和弟弟有时会为了玩具[打架]，但我们之后总会和好。

examples.english: Two little birds [fought] over a piece of bread in the park.
examples.chinese: 两只小鸟在公园里为了一块面包[打斗]起来。

common_collocations: give sb. an idea of the size
give sb. an idea of what to expect
give sb. an idea of how it works

meanings.explanation: If you [give someone an idea of] something, you help them get a rough understanding of what that thing is like.

examples.english: This drawing [gives me an idea of] what the dinosaur looks like.
examples.chinese: 这幅画让我[大概知道]恐龙长什么样子。

examples.english: Dad [gave me an idea of] how big our new puppy will be.
examples.chinese: 爸爸让我[大概知道]我们的新小狗会长到多大。

examples.english: Can you [give me an idea of] what your birthday cake will look like?
examples.chinese: 你能让我[大概了解]你的生日蛋糕会是什么样子吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [find out] something, you learn or discover something that you did not know before.

examples.english: I want to [find out] who ate my cookie.
examples.chinese: 我想[弄清楚]是谁吃了我的饼干。

examples.english: Yesterday we [found out] that our school trip is next week.
examples.chinese: 昨天我们[得知]学校旅行在下周。

examples.english: Can you help me [find out] how to open this box?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我[弄明白]怎么打开这个盒子吗？

meanings.explanation: A [dioxide] is a chemical compound that contains two oxygen atoms combined with another element.

examples.english: The most well-known [dioxide] is carbon dioxide, which helps plants grow.
examples.chinese: 最广为人知的[二氧化物]是二氧化碳，它能帮助植物生长。

examples.english: Another common [dioxide] is silicon dioxide, which makes up most sand.
examples.chinese: 另一种常见的[二氧化物]是二氧化硅，大部分沙子都由它构成。

examples.english: A [dioxide] forms when two oxygen atoms bond with another element.
examples.chinese: 当两个氧原子与另一种元素结合时，就形成了[二氧化物]。

meanings.explanation: If you [help someone do something], you make it easier for them to do it.

examples.english: Can you [help me carry] these books?
examples.chinese: 你能[帮我搬]这些书吗？

examples.english: Dad [helped me to fix] my bike.
examples.chinese: 爸爸[帮我修好了]自行车。

examples.english: I [helped my sister find] her toy.
examples.chinese: 我[帮妹妹找到了]她的玩具。

synonyms: make it easier for someone to do something
give someone a hand with something

meanings.explanation: A [hint] is a small piece of information that helps you find the answer to a question or understand something.

examples.english: The teacher gave me a [hint] to solve the puzzle.
examples.chinese: 老师给了我一个[提示]来解这个谜题。

examples.english: Here is a [hint]: the answer starts with the letter B.
examples.chinese: 给你一个[提示]：答案是以字母B开头的。

examples.english: My mom dropped a [hint] about my birthday gift.
examples.chinese: 妈妈[暗示]了一下我的生日礼物是什么。

meanings.explanation: If one thing can [lead to] another, it makes that other thing happen.

examples.english: Eating too much candy can [lead to] a tummy ache.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖可能会[引起]肚子疼。

examples.english: Hard work will [lead to] good grades.
examples.chinese: 努力学习会[带来]好成绩。

examples.english: The heavy rain [led to] a big flood in the town.
examples.chinese: 大雨[导致]镇上发生了大洪水。

common_collocations: give a talk/speech to a class

meanings.explanation: When you [give a talk/speech], you speak to a group of people about a subject.

examples.english: Our teacher will [give a talk/speech] about fire safety tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我们的老师明天要[发表演讲]，讲讲消防安全。

examples.english: Lily [gave a talk/speech] about her favorite animal at school.
examples.chinese: 莉莉在学校[发表了演讲]，介绍她最喜欢的动物。

examples.english: Dad is [giving a talk/speech] to my class today.
examples.chinese: 爸爸今天要给我们班[发表演讲]。

common_collocations: encourage someone to try new things

meanings.explanation: If you [encourage someone to do something], you say positive and supportive things to help them feel confident or brave enough to do it.

examples.english: My mom always [encourages me to try] new foods.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总是[鼓励]我尝试新的食物。

examples.english: Our teacher [encouraged us to ask] questions in class.
examples.chinese: 老师[鼓励]我们在课堂上提问。

examples.english: My best friend [encouraged me to join] the school soccer team.
examples.chinese: 我最好的朋友[鼓励]我加入学校足球队。

meanings.explanation: If you feel [lonely], you are sad because you are alone or do not have anyone to talk to or play with.

examples.english: The little puppy looked [lonely] in the big cage.
examples.chinese: 那只小狗在大笼子里看起来很[孤单]。

examples.english: I felt [lonely] when my best friend moved to another city.
examples.chinese: 我最好的朋友搬到另一个城市时，我感到很[孤独]。

examples.english: She was the [loneliest] girl in the whole school until she made a new friend.
examples.chinese: 在交到新朋友之前，她是全校最[孤单]的女孩。

meanings.explanation: An [invitation] is a written or spoken request asking someone to come to an event or visit a place.

examples.english: I got an [invitation] to Mia's birthday party.
examples.chinese: 我收到了米娅生日派对的[邀请]。

examples.english: Please bring this [invitation] to the school concert.
examples.chinese: 请带着这张[邀请函]来参加学校音乐会。

examples.english: We accepted Grandma's [invitation] to dinner.
examples.chinese: 我们接受了奶奶请我们吃晚饭的[邀请]。

meanings.explanation: If you [follow the example] of someone, you do what they did because you want to be like them or think they are right.

examples.english: I [follow the example] of my big sister and always say thank you.
examples.chinese: 我[效仿]姐姐，总是说谢谢。

examples.english: Tom [followed the example] of his friend and started reading before bed.
examples.chinese: 汤姆[以朋友为榜样]，开始睡前看书了。

examples.english: We should [follow the example] of people who are kind to others.
examples.chinese: 我们应该[效仿]那些对他人友善的人。

meanings.explanation: If you [lead] a group of people, you go in front of them to show them where to go or you are in charge of what they do.

examples.english: Our teacher will [lead] us to the playground.
examples.chinese: 老师会[带领]我们去操场。

examples.english: Last week, my big brother [led] our soccer team to win the game.
examples.chinese: 上周，我哥哥[带领]我们足球队赢了比赛。

examples.english: Can you [lead] the way to the snack bar?
examples.chinese: 你能[带路]去小吃店吗?

meanings.explanation: A [fruit] is the sweet, fleshy part of a plant that contains seeds and that you can eat, such as apples, bananas, and oranges.

examples.english: I eat an apple, my favorite [fruit], every morning.
examples.chinese: 我每天早上都吃一个苹果，我最喜欢的[水果]。

examples.english: My mom bought a lot of fresh [fruit] at the market.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈在市场上买了很多新鲜的[水果]。

examples.english: Do you want to have some [fruit] for dessert?
examples.chinese: 你想吃点[水果]当饭后甜点吗？

meanings.explanation: If one thing [matches] another, it has the same color, shape, or style, or looks good with it.

examples.english: My blue socks [match] my shirt.
examples.chinese: 我的蓝袜子和我的衬衫[相配]。

examples.english: These two puzzle pieces [match].
examples.chinese: 这两块拼图[正好吻合]。

examples.english: Can you find the lid that [matches] this box?
examples.chinese: 你能找到和这个盒子[配套]的盖子吗？

common_collocations: help my mom with the housework

meanings.explanation: If you [help sb. with sth.], you do things together with someone to make a job or task easier for them.

examples.english: Can you [help me with my homework]?
examples.chinese: 你能[帮我做作业]吗？

examples.english: I often [help my mom with the housework] after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后我经常[帮妈妈做家务]。

examples.english: My friend [helped me with my English project] yesterday.
examples.chinese: 昨天我的朋友[帮了我英语项目的忙]。

synonyms: give sb. a hand with sth.

meanings.explanation: If something [matters], it is important to you and you care about it.

examples.english: It doesn't [matter] if you make a mistake; everyone does sometimes.
examples.chinese: 犯错误没[关系]，每个人都会有这样的时候。

examples.english: What really [matters] is that you are kind to others.
examples.chinese: 真正[重要]的是你对别人友好。

examples.english: Taking care of our planet [matters] to everyone who lives here.
examples.chinese: 保护我们的地球对住在这里的每个人都很[重要]。

meanings.explanation: A [measurement] is the size, length, or amount of something that you find by measuring it.

examples.english: Mom took my [measurement] before buying new shoes.
examples.chinese: 妈妈买新鞋前量了我的[尺寸]。

examples.english: The [measurement] of this desk is 120 centimeters long.
examples.chinese: 这张课桌的[尺寸]是120厘米长。

examples.english: We need a [measurement] of the room to buy a new rug.
examples.chinese: 我们需要房间的[尺寸]来买新地毯。

meanings.explanation: An [organization] is a group of people who work together for a shared purpose or goal.

examples.english: Our school has a reading [organization] that helps kids love books.
examples.chinese: 我们学校有一个阅读[组织]，帮助孩子们爱上书籍。

examples.english: My aunt works for a charity [organization] that helps homeless animals.
examples.chinese: 我姑姑在一家帮助流浪动物的慈善[组织]工作。

examples.english: The children started an [organization] to keep the playground clean.
examples.chinese: 孩子们成立了一个[组织]来保持游乐场干净整洁。

meanings.explanation: [Oxygen] is a gas in the air that people, animals, and plants need to live.

examples.english: Fish get [oxygen] from the water through their gills.
examples.chinese: 鱼通过鳃从水中获取[氧气]。

examples.english: Trees give us [oxygen] so we can breathe.
examples.chinese: 树木为我们提供[氧气]，这样我们才能呼吸。

examples.english: The doctor put a mask on my face to help me get more [oxygen].
examples.chinese: 医生给我戴上口罩，帮我吸入更多[氧气]。

meanings.explanation: If you [measure] something, you find out its size, length, or amount using a tool such as a ruler or a cup.

examples.english: We use a ruler to [measure] how long the desk is.
examples.chinese: 我们用尺子[量]桌子的长度。

examples.english: Mom asked me to [measure] the flour with a cup.
examples.chinese: 妈妈让我用杯子[量]面粉。

examples.english: The doctor will [measure] how tall you are today.
examples.chinese: 医生今天会[量]你的身高。

meanings.explanation: A [membership] is the state of being an official member of a club, group, or organization, which gives you special rights or access.

examples.english: My dad has a gym [membership] and goes there every morning.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸有健身房的[会员]，每天早上都去。

examples.english: She got a library [membership] so she can borrow storybooks.
examples.chinese: 她办了图书馆的[会员]，这样就能借故事书了。

examples.english: We need a pool [membership] to use the swimming pool in summer.
examples.chinese: 夏天要用游泳池，我们需要办游泳馆的[会员]。

meanings.explanation: If two or more things are [matching], they have the same color, pattern, or design, so they look attractive when used together.

examples.english: My mom bought me a [matching] shirt and shorts for summer.
examples.chinese: 妈妈给我买了夏天穿的[配套的]上衣和短裤。

examples.english: My best friend and I have [matching] keychains.
examples.chinese: 我和我最好的朋友有[同款]钥匙扣。

examples.english: The bed has a [matching] pillow and blanket.
examples.chinese: 这张床上有一套[配套的]枕头和毯子。

meanings.explanation: A [pattern] is a design or group of shapes, colors, or actions that repeats in a regular way.

examples.english: The [pattern] on my shirt has blue stars.
examples.chinese: 我衬衫上的[图案]是蓝色的星星。

examples.english: I can see a [pattern] of red, yellow, red, and yellow.
examples.chinese: 我能看出红、黄、红、黄这样的[规律]。

examples.english: We made a paper [pattern] with circles and squares.
examples.chinese: 我们用圆形和正方形做了一个纸[图样]。

meanings.explanation: If people [line up], they stand in a row, one behind another, often waiting for something.

examples.english: The students [line up] outside the classroom every morning.
examples.chinese: 同学们每天早上在教室外面[排队]。

examples.english: Please [line up] for the school bus.
examples.chinese: 请[排好队]等候校车。

examples.english: The kids [lined up] to get ice cream.
examples.chinese: 孩子们[排好队]等着买冰淇淋。

meanings.explanation: A [medicine] is something you take or use to help you get better when you are ill.

examples.english: The doctor gave me some [medicine] for my cough.
examples.chinese: 医生给了我一些治咳嗽的[药]。

examples.english: I take my [medicine] after breakfast.
examples.chinese: 我早餐后吃[药]。

examples.english: Mom keeps the [medicine] in a high cupboard.
examples.chinese: 妈妈把[药]放在高高的柜子里。

meanings.explanation: A [photograph] is a picture that is made using a camera.

examples.english: My mom keeps a [photograph] of me as a baby in her wallet.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈的钱包里放着一张我婴儿时期的[照片]。

examples.english: We took a [photograph] together at the zoo last weekend.
examples.chinese: 上周末我们一起在动物园拍了一张[照片]。

examples.english: This old [photograph] shows my grandma when she was a little girl.
examples.chinese: 这张旧[照片]记录了我奶奶小时候的样子。

meanings.explanation: A [member] is a person who belongs to a group, club, or family.

examples.english: My aunt is a [member] of the city book club.
examples.chinese: 我阿姨是城市读书俱乐部的[成员]。

examples.english: I am a [member] of my school soccer team.
examples.chinese: 我是学校足球队的[成员]。

examples.english: Cousin Lisa is the youngest [member] of our family.
examples.chinese: 丽莎表姐是我们家最年轻的[成员]。

meanings.explanation: A [possibility] is something that may happen or may be true.

examples.english: There is a [possibility] that it will rain tomorrow, so bring your umbrella.
examples.chinese: 明天[可能]会下雨，所以带上伞吧。

examples.english: Is there a [possibility] that we can finish our homework before dinner?
examples.chinese: 我们晚饭前有没有[可能]做完作业？

examples.english: The teacher said there is a [possibility] of a field trip next month.
examples.chinese: 老师说下个月[可能]会有一次春游。

meanings.explanation: A [plantation] is a very large farm where people grow crops such as coffee, tea, rubber, or bananas.

examples.english: My friend lives near a big tea [plantation] in the mountains.
examples.chinese: 我的朋友住在山里一个很大的[茶园]附近。

examples.english: We saw rows of banana trees on the [plantation].
examples.chinese: 我们在[种植园]里看到了成排的香蕉树。

examples.english: The farmer needs help picking coffee beans on his [plantation].
examples.chinese: 农场主需要帮手在他的[种植园]里采摘咖啡豆。

meanings.explanation: [Photography] is the art or hobby of taking pictures with a camera.

examples.english: My dad loves [photography] and takes pictures of birds in the park.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸热爱[摄影]，经常在公园里拍鸟。

examples.english: I want to learn [photography] so I can take good photos of my friends.
examples.chinese: 我想学[摄影]，这样就能给朋友们拍好看的照片。

examples.english: She takes a [photography] class after school every Tuesday.
examples.chinese: 她每周二放学后去上[摄影]课。

meanings.explanation: If something will [probably] happen, it is very likely to happen, but you are not completely sure.

examples.english: It will [probably] rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
examples.chinese: 明天[很可能]会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

examples.english: My mom will [probably] be home at six o'clock.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈[大概]六点钟会到家。

examples.english: I will [probably] go to the park after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后我[可能]会去公园。

meanings.explanation: A [powerful] person or thing has a lot of strength, force, or ability to produce a great effect.

examples.english: The [powerful] superhero can lift a heavy car above his head.
examples.chinese: 这个[强大的]超级英雄能把沉重的汽车举过头顶。

examples.english: A [powerful] storm knocked down many trees in our town last week.
examples.chinese: 上周一场[强劲的]暴风雨吹倒了我们镇上很多树。

examples.english: My dad has [powerful] arms that can carry me and my brother at the same time.
examples.chinese: 爸爸有[强壮有力的]胳膊，能同时抱起我和弟弟。

common_collocations: have the power to do something

meanings.explanation: If someone has the [power] to do something, they have the ability or right to control it or make a decision about it.

examples.english: The school principal has the [power] to change the school rules.
examples.chinese: 校长有[权力]修改校规。

examples.english: The team captain has the [power] to choose who plays first.
examples.chinese: 队长有[权力]决定谁先上场。

examples.english: Parents have the [power] to make rules for their children.
examples.chinese: 父母有[权力]为孩子制定规则。

meanings.explanation: [Reforestation] is the act of planting new trees in a place where trees were cut down or burned.

examples.english: After the big fire, the town started a [reforestation] project to plant new trees on the hill.
examples.chinese: 大火过后，镇上启动了一个[植树造林]项目，在山上种上了新树。

examples.english: Our class joined a [reforestation] event and planted twenty baby trees in the park.
examples.chinese: 我们班参加了一个[植树造林]活动，在公园里种了二十棵小树苗。

examples.english: Many animals will come back to the forest because of [reforestation].
examples.chinese: 由于[重新造林]，许多动物会回到森林里来。

meanings.explanation: A [result] is what happens or what you get after you do something.

examples.english: I studied hard, and the [result] was a good grade.
examples.chinese: 我努力学习了，[结果]得了个好成绩。

examples.english: What was the [result] of the soccer game?
examples.chinese: 那场足球赛的[结果]怎么样？

examples.english: She looked at her test [results] and felt very happy.
examples.chinese: 她看了自己的考试[成绩]，非常开心。

meanings.explanation: If you [rely] on someone or something, you trust them to help you or do what you need.

examples.english: I [rely] on my mom to wake me up.
examples.chinese: 我[依靠]妈妈叫我起床。

examples.english: When I forget my pencil, I [rely] on my friend to lend me one.
examples.chinese: 我忘带铅笔时，就[指望]朋友借我一支。

examples.english: We [rely] on the school bus to get to school every day.
examples.chinese: 我们每天[靠]校车去上学。

meanings.explanation: A [scene] is a place where something happens, or a short part of a movie, play, or book that happens in one place.

examples.english: Firefighters arrived at the [scene] of the fire very quickly.
examples.chinese: 消防员很快赶到了火灾[现场]。

examples.english: My favorite [scene] in the movie is when the puppy finds its way home.
examples.chinese: 这部电影里我最喜欢的[场景]是小狗找到回家的路。

examples.english: We stopped at the top of the hill to enjoy the beautiful [scene].
examples.chinese: 我们在山顶停下来欣赏美丽的[景色]。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [right away], you do it immediately, without any delay.

examples.english: When Mom calls me for dinner, I come [right away].
examples.chinese: 妈妈叫我吃饭时，我[马上]就过去。

examples.english: Please clean up your toys [right away] before we go out.
examples.chinese: 请在我们出门前[立刻]把你的玩具收拾好。

examples.english: The teacher told us to start the test [right away].
examples.chinese: 老师让我们[立即]开始做测验。

meanings.explanation: If something [results in] something else, it makes that thing happen.

examples.english: Eating too much candy can [result in] a stomachache.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖果会[导致]肚子疼。

examples.english: Not wearing a helmet could [result in] a bad injury.
examples.chinese: 不戴头盔可能会[造成]重伤。

examples.english: His hard work [resulted in] a prize at school.
examples.chinese: 他的努力[带来]了学校的一个奖项。

meanings.explanation: To [reforest] a place means to plant new trees there, especially where trees have been cut down or lost.

examples.english: Our class helped [reforest] the park by planting little trees.
examples.chinese: 我们全班一起种小树苗，帮公园[重新种树]。

examples.english: After the big fire, many people came to [reforest] the mountain.
examples.chinese: 大火过后，很多人来山上[重新种树]。

examples.english: The volunteers worked together to [reforest] the empty hillside.
examples.chinese: 志愿者们一起在光秃秃的山坡上[重新种树]。

meanings.explanation: When you [set out], you leave a place and begin a journey.

examples.english: We [set out] for the park after breakfast.
examples.chinese: 我们吃完早饭后就[出发]去公园。

examples.english: Mom and I [set out] early to visit Grandma.
examples.chinese: 妈妈和我一早[出发]去看望奶奶。

examples.english: Our family [set out] on a sunny morning.
examples.chinese: 我们全家在一个阳光明媚的早晨[出发]了。

meanings.explanation: A [photographer] is a person who takes pictures with a camera.

examples.english: My aunt is a [photographer] and she takes beautiful pictures of flowers.
examples.chinese: 我阿姨是一名[摄影师]，她拍的鲜花照片特别漂亮。

examples.english: The [photographer] at our school took everyone's class photo today.
examples.chinese: 今天学校里的[摄影师]给大家拍了合影。

examples.english: I want to be a [photographer] when I grow up because I love taking photos.
examples.chinese: 我长大后想当一名[摄影师]，因为我特别喜欢拍照。

meanings.explanation: [Space] is the huge area beyond the Earth's sky where stars, planets, and moons are found.

examples.english: I want to be an astronaut and travel to [space].
examples.chinese: 我想当宇航员，去[太空]旅行。

examples.english: At night, we can see millions of stars in [space].
examples.chinese: 晚上，我们可以看见[太空]里无数颗星星。

examples.english: The rocket took off and flew into [space].
examples.chinese: 火箭起飞了，飞向了[太空]。

meanings.explanation: A [shoeprint] is a mark left by a shoe on a surface.

examples.english: There's a muddy [shoeprint] on our clean floor.
examples.chinese: 我们干净的地板上有一个带泥的[鞋印]。

examples.english: The police found a clear [shoeprint] near the window.
examples.chinese: 警察在窗户边发现了一个清晰的[鞋印]。

examples.english: I found a big [shoeprint] in the wet sand.
examples.chinese: 我在湿沙子里发现了一个大大的[鞋印]。

meanings.explanation: If a place is [spacious], it has a lot of room inside and does not feel small or crowded.

examples.english: Our new classroom is very [spacious].
examples.chinese: 我们的新教室很[宽敞]。

examples.english: The [spacious] garden is perfect for playing tag.
examples.chinese: 这个[宽敞]的花园很适合玩捉人游戏。

examples.english: Grandma's living room is [spacious] enough for all of us to dance.
examples.chinese: 奶奶的客厅很[宽敞]，足够我们所有人跳舞。

meanings.explanation: A [record] is a written or stored collection of information that is kept for future reference.

examples.english: The school keeps a [record] of every student's attendance every year.
examples.chinese: 学校每年都会保存每个学生的出勤[记录]。

examples.english: My mom keeps a [record] of all the money our family spends each month.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈会保存我们家每个月开支的[记录]。

examples.english: The doctor keeps a [record] of all my childhood vaccinations.
examples.chinese: 医生保存着我所有儿童疫苗接种的[记录]。

meanings.explanation: When you [speak], you use your voice to say words to someone.

examples.english: Please [speak] slowly so I can understand you.
examples.chinese: 请[说]慢一点，这样我才能听懂。

examples.english: My little sister just learned to [speak] her first words.
examples.chinese: 我的小妹妹刚刚学会[说]她的第一个词。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to [speak] in class about our favorite animals.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们在课堂上[讲]讲自己最喜欢的动物。

meanings.explanation: [Theft] is the act of taking something that belongs to someone else without permission.

examples.english: My bike was taken last night, and I told my dad about the [theft].
examples.chinese: 我的自行车昨晚被拿走了，我把[失窃]的事告诉了爸爸。

examples.english: The store has cameras to stop [theft].
examples.chinese: 商店装了摄像头来防止[偷窃]。

examples.english: The police found the lost dog and said it was not a case of [theft].
examples.chinese: 警察找到了走丢的小狗，并说这不是[盗窃]案。

meanings.explanation: A [step] is a single movement you make with your foot when walking or moving somewhere.

examples.english: I took a big [step] over the dirty puddle.
examples.chinese: 我跨了一大[步]跳过了脏水洼。

examples.english: When baby Lily learns to walk, every [step] makes her dad cheer.
examples.chinese: 莉莉宝宝学走路时，每一[步]都让爸爸欢呼。

examples.english: One wrong [step] on the ice will make you fall down.
examples.chinese: 在冰上走错一[步]就会让你摔倒。

meanings.explanation: A [trillion] is a very big number. It is 1,000,000,000,000 — that is one thousand billions.

examples.english: There are more than a [trillion] stars in our galaxy.
examples.chinese: 我们的银河系里有超过一[万亿]颗星星。

examples.english: My dad says it would take a [trillion] years to count that high.
examples.chinese: 爸爸说要数到一[万亿]需要花很多很多年。

examples.english: A [trillion] ants would weigh more than a blue whale!
examples.chinese: 一[万亿]只蚂蚁比一头蓝鲸还要重！

meanings.explanation: A [speech] is a talk that someone gives to a group of people, usually about a particular subject.

examples.english: I gave a [speech] at the school assembly.
examples.chinese: 我在学校集会上做了一次[演讲]。

examples.english: Dad wrote a short [speech] for my birthday party.
examples.chinese: 爸爸为我的生日会写了一篇简短的[演讲稿]。

examples.english: Lily gave a [speech] about keeping the park clean.
examples.chinese: 莉莉发表了一篇关于保持公园清洁的[演讲]。

meanings.explanation: A [tyre] is a thick rubber cover around a wheel, filled with air, that helps a car, bicycle, or other vehicle move.

examples.english: The back [tyre] on my bicycle is flat.
examples.chinese: 我自行车后面的[轮胎]没气了。

examples.english: Please check the car's [tyres] before the trip.
examples.chinese: 出发前请检查一下汽车的[轮胎]。

examples.english: The bus got a new [tyre] after the old one broke.
examples.chinese: 旧轮胎坏了以后，公交车换了一个新的[轮胎]。

meanings.explanation: If you [tire], you feel that you have no energy left and need to rest.

examples.english: I [tire] quickly when I run up the stairs.
examples.chinese: 我跑上楼很快就会[累]。

examples.english: The long walk [tired] the puppy.
examples.chinese: 长途散步让小狗[累了]。

examples.english: Playing outside all day [tires] me.
examples.chinese: 在外面玩一整天让我[累了]。

meanings.explanation: A [vehicle] is a machine that is used to carry people or goods from one place to another, usually on land.

examples.english: Our family’s car is a [vehicle] that takes us to the park on weekends.
examples.chinese: 我们家的汽车是周末带我们去公园的[交通工具]。

examples.english: A school bus is a special [vehicle] that takes children to and from school.
examples.chinese: 校车是接送孩子上下学的专用[交通工具]。

examples.english: A delivery truck is a [vehicle] that brings our packages to our house.
examples.chinese: 送货卡车是给我们家送包裹的[交通工具]。

meanings.explanation: [Surgery] is a medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into a person's body to fix or remove something that is not working right.

examples.english: The doctor said Grandpa needs [surgery] on his knee.
examples.chinese: 医生说爷爷的膝盖需要做[手术]。

examples.english: She was very brave when she had [surgery] at the hospital.
examples.chinese: 她在医院做[手术]的时候非常勇敢。

examples.english: My friend is resting at home after his [surgery].
examples.chinese: 我的朋友做完[手术]后在家里休息。

meanings.explanation: [Soil] is the dark, soft earth that plants grow in.

examples.english: The [soil] in our garden is great for growing flowers.
examples.chinese: 我们花园里的[土]很适合种花。

examples.english: Plants need good [soil] to grow strong.
examples.chinese: 植物需要好的[土壤]才能长得壮。

examples.english: I got [soil] on my hands when I planted the seeds.
examples.chinese: 我种种子的时候手上沾了[土]。
